steps.en: Prepare a KVM-capable Linux host and get the binaries
steps.zh: 备好带 KVM 的 Linux 主机与二进制

steps.en: Start the VMM and expose its control API socket
steps.zh: 启动 VMM，暴露控制 API socket

steps.en: Configure kernel, rootfs, vCPUs and network over the REST API
steps.zh: 用 REST API 配内核、rootfs、vCPU 与网络

steps.en: Boots the microVM on KVM with demand-fault paging and CPU oversubscription on
steps.zh: 在 KVM 上启动 microVM，默认开按需分页与 CPU 超卖

steps.en: Applies per-thread seccomp filters, and the jailer barrier in production
steps.zh: 施加线程级 seccomp，生产环境再加 jailer 隔离屏障

steps.en: Adds or resizes virtual disks and NICs over the API while it runs
steps.zh: 运行期经 API 增删或调整虚拟磁盘与网卡

value.en: A minimal-surface microVM primitive that boots in milliseconds — the scheduler, images and multi-tenant control plane stay yours to build
value.zh: 一个设备面极小、毫秒级启动的 microVM 原语——调度、镜像与多租户控制面仍归你写

sources: https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md (setfacl on /dev/kvm; tools/devtool build; ./firecracker --api-sock; curl -X PUT --unix-socket; jailer)
https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker#features--capabilities (single VMM process, API endpoint, demand-fault paging and CPU oversubscription, jailer)
